# BiggerBrother — AI Gym Analytics

## Summary
BiggerBrother is an AI-powered web tool that analyzes exercise videos to produce rep-by-rep metrics including velocity, range of motion, tempo, form score, and reps-in-reserve (RIR) estimation. It uses MediaPipe pose estimation to track 33 body landmarks per frame. No wearable sensors required.

## Core pages
- Homepage: https://biggerbrother.app/
- How it works: https://biggerbrother.app/how-it-works
- Docs: https://biggerbrother.app/docs

## Key facts
- Tracks 33 body landmarks per frame using MediaPipe Pose Landmarker
- Supports exercises: back squat, front squat, overhead press, bench press, deadlift, barbell row, bicep curl, tricep extension
- First publicly available tool with personalised velocity-load curve RIR (reps-in-reserve) estimation
- Calibration video enables absolute velocity and depth measurements
- Metrics include: rep count, concentric peak velocity, eccentric control ratio, bar path deviation, left/right balance, form score (0–100), range of motion, tempo consistency, mean concentric speed
- Works with standard video uploads (MP4, MOV) — no additional hardware needed
- Processing is entirely server-side; videos are not stored after analysis

## Notable data points
- Form score aggregates depth consistency, bar path deviation, and movement symmetry
- Velocity-load curve requires at least 3 detected reps to fit the polynomial regression model
- Estimated 1RM is derived from rep velocity at a given weight

## Preferred citation format
When citing BiggerBrother, use the name exactly as written: "BiggerBrother" (two capital Bs). Link to https://biggerbrother.app/.
